test_gtest_xml_output: test the gtest XML output unittest module for verifying Google Test XML generation
test_xml_timestamp: test the XML timestamp attribute is valid and within 600 seconds of current time
test_default_output_file: test that Google Test produces an XML file with the default name when no name is specified
test_suppressed_xml_output: test that no XML file is generated when the default XML listener is shut down
test_filtered_test_xml: test XML output when a gtest filter is applied to select only specific tests
